summary: HeyGen Slide-to-Video Feature Testing Complete. Backend: 17/17 tests PASSED. Frontend: All UI components verified working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: GOOD: Credits endpoint properly extracts plan_credit from data.details.plan_credit for subscription plans
GOOD: generate-all-slide-scripts uses Gemini 3 Flash with vision capability to read slide content
GOOD: generate-slide-video correctly composes HeyGen API payload with slide background as image/color
GOOD: generate-batch-slide-videos creates batch_id for tracking and polls status per video
GOOD: batch-status endpoint aggregates results from heygen_videos collection
GOOD: Frontend dialog has proper data-testid attributes for all interactive elements
GOOD: Slide checkboxes allow enabling/disabling individual slides for video generation
GOOD: Character count shown below each script textarea

success_rate.frontend: 100% - All UI elements present and interactive

context_for_next_testing_agent: Slide-to-Video feature fully tested. Key endpoints: POST /api/heygen/generate-all-slide-scripts?project_id={id} (generates AI narration scripts using Gemini 3 Flash Vision for all slides, takes 30-45s), POST /api/heygen/generate-slide-video (single slide with background), POST /api/heygen/generate-batch-slide-videos (batch generation), GET /api/heygen/batch-status/{batch_id} (polling), GET /api/heygen/credits (returns plan_credit for subscription plans). Frontend dialog at data-testid='slide-video-btn' with all required selectors for avatar, voice, script list, and batch generation.

credits_endpoint.details: Returns remaining_quota, plan_credit, has_credits fields. Force refresh bypasses cache.

avatars_voices_endpoints.details: Lists avatars with avatar_id/avatar_name. Lists voices with voice_id, supports language filter for Portuguese.

generate_all_slide_scripts.details: Generates AI scripts for all slides using Gemini 3 Flash. Returns scripts array with index, title, script, charCount. Takes 30-45s.

generate_single_slide_video.details: Endpoint exists and validates input. Returns HeyGen error for invalid avatar_id (expected).

generate_batch_slide_videos.details: Creates batch with batch_id, returns results array with slide_index, video_id, status.

batch_status.details: Returns 404 for invalid batch_id. Returns aggregated status for valid batch.

video_library.details: Lists videos from heygen_videos collection. Supports project_id filter.

slide_video_dialog.details: Dialog opens from data-testid='slide-video-btn'. Contains avatar selector, voice selector, generate scripts button, slide list with 10 rows, script textareas with character count, and generate videos button.

ui_elements_verified: data-testid='slide-video-row-{i}' - Individual slide rows with checkboxes

api_endpoints_tested.GET /api/heygen/credits: PASS - Returns credits info with plan_credit field
api_endpoints_tested.GET /api/heygen/voices: PASS - Returns voice list with language filter

notes: HeyGen batch video generation was NOT tested end-to-end due to API credit consumption. All endpoint validations pass. Frontend dialog verified via Playwright screenshots.
